answer: Unfortunately, no. The old notarized form NW-POA-1 was replaced by NW-POA-2 on February 1, 2026, and an NW-POA-1 signed before that date is only accepted until June 30, 2026, which is before your July 10 appointment. Your mom can sign the new NW-POA-2 instead, which can be signed electronically with no notary. If you're in Georgia, though, NW-POA-2 must still be notarized.
